define: exp2 is the second improvement cycle. It was run after the DMAIC proposal-history change was merged (commits 1c51f2e and a8ab3a9, merged into main as e655d23), so the improve phase showed the improvement agent the earlier proposal v2, rejected in exp1 on R2 (enabling /checks/venue_match), with its development-case outcome, and the validator refuses an exact repeat of a rejected change set. The baseline is fresh, under the pinned v1 on memory snapshot M0. The case set is the same six cases as exp1: the three default cases (D1, H1, P1) and the three optional race-audit cases (D2, H2, P2), all published in data/cases.json before any harness code. The optional cases are included because the only default development case, D1, has zero races at its venue and so cannot exhibit citation defects; they were fixed in advance and were used, not added. Every pilot arm covers the same six cases.
